subject.title: [Feature]: Clickable file links in chat with file viewer sidebar; workspace navigator previews any in-root file

question: Should the Control UI file viewer read any fs-safe in-root workspace file from the session UI now, and if so should it use the existing `sessions.files.get` path or the newer `agents.workspace.*` read-only API?
rationale: The user problem is source-reproducible and aligned with web ergonomics, but the implementation choice changes a workspace file-read boundary and the item is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Review the linked Control UI PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100679 as the candidate fix and require maintainer/security sign-off on the read-scope behavior before merge.

options.title: Retarget to `agents.workspace.*`
options.body: Ask the implementation to reuse or bridge the newer agent-scoped read-only workspace RPCs before changing the session file API.

options.title: Keep transcript-only previews
options.body: Reject the workspace-wide preview behavior for now and leave the issue open or close it only after an explicit product decision.

recommendation.title: Review the linked Control UI PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100679 as the candidate fix and require maintainer/security sign-off on the read-scope behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the issue/linked PR context and recently merged the adjacent workspace browsing API work.
